status: designed calibration; frozen before primary optimizer execution
not_held_out: The coordinator derived these test families before freezing this file. This is not external unseen transfer or an empirical AI experiment.
contract: Finite rational feature rows on Omega, nonempty target D. Free rows plus costed optional row blocks. Select minimum-cost blocks admitting W_D=0 and W_off>=1; clear denominators to get integral product-stable weights.

generated_target.target: at least one coordinate is zero
generated_target.free_rows: constant and coordinate monomials of total degree <=1
generated_target.optional_blocks: one row per reduced monomial with each exponent 0..2 and total degree >=2
generated_target.cost: 1 for every optional monomial except exponent (2,2), whose cost is 5
tests: separate analytic degree lower bound for every dimension

frozen_baselines: Exact facial feasibility on the same feature matrix
Exhaustive mask search with the identical exact oracle
Static original-ray hitting as an explicitly rejected shortcut
cost_scope: Optional-block costs only. Record oracle calls and master candidates separately. No wall-clock or asymptotic speed improvement is asserted. The exact reference oracle may enumerate convex-hull faces.
